messages:
support_amy: FYI — support case from Acme. After they upgraded our client SDK, a subset of Decrypt calls are returning 403 AccessDenied. Happens ~2% of requests, started after deploy this morning. Noticed CloudTrail shows EncryptionContext mismatch for the failing calls. Request id: req-0a1b2c3d. tagging @eng_sec_dan @eng_infra_lee
eng_sec_dan: Can you paste one of the failing Decrypt logs (CloudTrail event) and the EncryptionContext we expected vs what KMS saw? curious if keys are reordered or truncated.
support_amy: Paste below — I redacted some tenant ids but kept shapes. failing cloudtrail event (trimmed):
```
{ "eventTime":"2026-03-17T08:12:34Z", "eventName":"Decrypt", "requestParameters": { "ciphertextBlob":"<base64>", "encryptionContext": "{\"user_id\":\"u-123\",\"session_meta\":\"eyJ2IjoiMS4wIiwicCI6Int...TRUNCATED\"}" }, "responseElements": { "errorCode":"AccessDenied" } }
```
Expected encctx (from app logs):
```
{"user_id":"u-123","session_meta":"eyJ2IjoiMS4wIiwicCI6IntcIm9mZnNcIjoxMjM0NTY3ODk..."}
```
Note the failing encctx in CloudTrail has a "...TRUNCATED" in the string; customer says their session_meta is large (~8KB) and we recently switched to a new header encoding in SDK v2.4.1.
sdk_julia: I can reproduce locally. SDK v2.4.1 started sending serialized encryptionContext in an HTTP header rather than in the body for performance; some proxies (nginx/ALB) trim headers beyond 4KB and we end up sending truncated JSON — KMS then rejects because the enc ctx doesn't match the expected map. Repro script (node):
```
// repro: node repro-encctx.js
const AWS = require('redwood-kms-sdk@2.4.1');
const long = 'x'.repeat(8000);
kms.decrypt({ CiphertextBlob: '...', EncryptionContext: { user_id: 'u-123', session_meta: Buffer.from(long).toString('base64') } })
```
You should see header >4096 bytes and the proxy will truncate.
eng_infra_lee: This looks like a proxy header size issue. Check nginx config for client_header_buffer_size and large_client_header_buffers and ALB limits. Also check any API GW/L7 middleboxes that might rewrite. Command to check our edge nginx: `kubectl exec -c nginx -n ingress -- cat /etc/nginx/nginx.conf | grep client_header_buffer_size -n`
support_amy: Customer confirms they hit our ALB in front of the KMS proxy. They upgraded app at 08:05 and errors started ~08:10. Billing spike due to retries; they sent ~3x traffic for 10m.
eng_sec_dan: Two immediate asks: 1) short-term mitigation we can recommend to customer; 2) platform mitigations so other customers not hit. For 1) tell them to pin SDK to 2.4.0 or set env `REDWOOD_KMS_ENCCTX_SEND_IN_BODY=true` (internal flag) — we should include that in the support KB. For 2) we can make the KMS proxy validate header length and return 4xx with clear message instead of forwarding truncated header to KMS, and add a transform to hash/shorten large encctx values.
sdk_julia: Workaround in SDK: we can base64-compress session_meta and/or send a reference token instead of the full payload. We'll push a patch to revert the header change in 2.4.2 if ops prefers.
eng_infra_lee: Ops followups: check ALB header limit (16KB for ALB? depends), but nginx default buffer is much smaller. I can push a safe nginx config bump to 16k for client_header_buffer_size and large_client_header_buffers on ingress tomorrow AM. Need approver for config change.
support_amy: Filed support ticket CC'ing customer with suggested short-term steps (pin SDK / reduce encctx size). Customer asked about credits for retry costs.
acct_mike: If retries caused measurable extra usage we typically offer a one-time credit after validation. Keep me posted on final remediation timeline.
eng_sec_dan: Security implications: encryptionContext is part of KMS auth; truncation can produce a valid JSON but different map, so KMS denies — no data exfil but potential for customer-facing errors and throttled retries. We should also audit CloudTrail for any encrypted decrypts that succeeded with altered encctx to rule out more serious issues.
support_amy: I ran a quick CloudTrail query for the last 2 hours and saw only failures for that request id range, no successful decrypts with altered encctx.
eng_infra_lee: I'll add an alert rule: if KMS Decrypt AccessDenied rate > 0.5% for 5m spike, page eng-infra. Deploy bot: request deploy/alert creation.
deploy-bot: Alert created: KMS_DECRYPT_403_SPIKE (threshold: 0.5% over 5m). dashboard: https://redwood/ops/alerts/1123 :thumbsup:
eng_sec_dan: Action items = (1) support KB edit + customer remediation steps (support_amy), (2) SDK patch to revert header change (sdk_julia), (3) ingress config bump + deploy (eng_infra_lee), (4) add KMS 403 spike alert (done), (5) consider server-side encctx-hash transform (eng_sec_dan + eng_infra_lee).
support_amy: I'll update ticket and note potential credit request for acct_mike. Thanks all. :pray:
eng_sec_dan: tagging for follow-up in postmortem channel once we close: please include repro steps and timeline.
